name: Can an in-law suite be rented out for income?

mainEntity.name: Can an in-law suite be rented out for income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many areas of Los Angeles, an in-law suite (ADU) can be legally rented out to provide rental income. Recent state laws have eased restrictions, making it more feasible for homeowners to utilize ADUs as long-term rentals. This can be a significant financial benefit, helping offset mortgage payments or construction costs. However, local regulations regarding short-term rentals (like Airbnb) may vary and could be more restrictive. We recommend consulting with us to understand the specific rental opportunities and regulations applicable to your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, in-law suites can often be rented out for long-term income in Los Angeles, but local regulations on short-term rentals may vary.
